name: ui-check
description: Execute ui-check: steps in test specs — compare the live page currently open in the browser under test against a declared design baseline: a Figma frame (identifier only; file + token configured once per project) or a screenshot image, in exact mode (every visible detail) or reference mode (only enumerated details can fail). Triggers on spec steps starting with "ui-check:", or requests like "check this page against the design", "compare with the Figma frame", "does the screen match the mockup". Baselines are resolved by the bundled fetch_baseline.js runner — an unresolvable baseline is BLOCKED, never improvised; the comparison verdict itself is agent-vision judgment.
